purpose: Teach: ウインドウ/バッファ/パッド/万能/ニセ/ホームステイ/舞踊/アンサンブル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが店のウインドウを磨いてらしたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — back when your father was young, he used to polish the shop window.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic opening. Soft voice, as if reaching back through time. Measured pace, lingering slightly on the memory. A small smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃんは時間にバッファをつくる方でしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, your grandfather was always one to build time into everything, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, rambling affection. A slight lift in her voice as she meets him in the memory. Comfortable, like they've had this conversation many times before. Gentle prod forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは肩のパッドを取り外して着てらしたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — back when your father was young, he'd remove the shoulder pads from his clothes before wearing them.
lines.style: Same wistful reach, but softer—a detail that still touches him. Quiet appreciation in the tempo. Eyes perhaps looking away, seeing it clearly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、万能道具をご愛用だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was absolutely devoted to that multi-tool of his, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate chuckle underneath. She's following his lead but gently shifting the memory. Tender, knowingly off-topic. A wife's gentle teasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんがニセモノに騙されたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — back when your father was young, you were taken in by a counterfeit.
lines.style: More hesitant now. The wistfulness deepens—this memory has a tender, slightly vulnerable edge. Slower pace. Checking his own honesty as he says it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、海外ホームステイの方を受け入れたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather opened our home to an exchange student from overseas, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Brighter now, redirecting with purpose. Her voice steadies—she knows where he's heading and gently corrects the record. Warm but firm, the way a wife knows her husband's heart.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは伝統舞踊のお話をされたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — back when your father was young, he used to tell stories about traditional dance.
lines.style: Softer landing. The wistfulness settles into something almost restful. Voice lightens fractionally—this is a softer memory. Slower, almost dreaming.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、合唱のアンサンブルがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather did have such a fondness for singing in the choir ensemble, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Close, tender whisper—as if leaning in. Soft smile in every word. She's gathered him back home. Intimate, unhurried. The final note of their shared song.
